description: Αρχείο Μελετών Προμηθειών Τμήματος Οδοποιίας και Οδικής Σήμανσης Δήμου Θεσσαλονίκης is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Τμήμα Οδοποιίας και Οδικής Σήμανσης. Datový soubor obsahuje otázky studií zadávání veřejných zakázek odboru výstavby silnic a dopravních značek ředitelství pro udržitelnou mobilitu a sítě. Coverage: Τμήμα Οδοποιίας και Οδικής Σήμανσης. The portal shows the English title as "Arhiv nabavnih študij Oddelka za gradnjo cest in podpisovanje cest Občine Solun" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Τμήμα Οδοποιίας και Οδικής Σήμανσης. Its keywords include Προμήθειες, Οδοποιία, repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση, Μελέτες. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-04-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
